description: Small, inspectable project recipes consumed by the common drafting kernel.
principles: Recipes configure intent; they do not replace canonical geometry or validation.
A missing fact remains unknown and must not be invented by a recipe.
Presentation suggestions are downstream of validated topology.

residential.label: Residential
briefPrompts: Confirm plot, north, road access, occupants, privacy, and future expansion.
Capture bedrooms, living, kitchen, wet areas, storage, and vertical circulation.
optimizationChecks: continuous route to every occupied room
daylight and ventilation intent recorded per habitable room
furniture clearances checked after layout generation

commercial.label: Commercial
briefPrompts: Confirm customer entry, staff entry, service/loading access, operating hours, and occupancy.
Capture public, staff, storage, sanitary, and emergency route classes.
optimizationChecks: public and service circulation remain distinct
queue and waiting capacity does not block required routes
delivery path reaches the service zone
accessible approach is explicit rather than inferred

institutional.label: Institutional / civic
briefPrompts: Confirm public entry, staff/service entry, assembly capacity, and emergency access.
Capture reception, assembly, stage/dais, library, discussion, office, and service uses.
optimizationChecks: assembly seating preserves aisles and exit routes
public, staff, service, and vertical routes are traceable
stage/dais and library support are reachable without crossing service zones
site frontage and service access remain explicit review items when unconfirmed

industrial.label: Industrial / light industrial
briefPrompts: Confirm vehicle access, loading, turning, hazardous or restricted zones, and worker occupancy.
Capture equipment footprints, service sides, maintenance clearances, and emergency routes.
optimizationChecks: vehicle and pedestrian routes are separately modelled
equipment service sides and maintenance clearances remain open
loading and turning assumptions are visible
fire, egress, and hazardous-use checks stay rule-pack and professional-review dependent
